reason: Mostly holds. As of 10:35Z (poll header 10:33:21Z, 56629533 PENDING) no logged line codes exp87a or exp83c. That would call K+CI additive, or make SEC '+', when the file only ties exp79a (CI alone). That misreading is the real risk, so a pre-score rule is worth one CONTEXT line. It costs nothing: no code, no runtime, no slot, and it is within R1-R10 pre-registration. Timing checks out. 28 Sep UTC already has 4 submits (47 at 00:06:09, 48 at 00:06:33, 49 at 00:50:37, 50 at 05:02:30), so probe 51 is the day's 5th and last. It completes alone at about 21:30-22:20Z, so count 52->53 is a clean single completion with k clean. The value claim is overstated in two places. (a) V_pub is already settled by the finals-card tie order (attributable UP > non-CI > fewer levers > earlier submit) plus the R19-A1 ORDER rule ('after an UP, later probes must beat the NEW best'). (b) The W4 AMEND 3 freeze logs the codes of exp80a/exp81/exp86c, not exp87a/exp83c, so the new code matters for three things only: the SEC(b) clause (PC25-02), Q3, and the 29 Sep stack choice. The proposed action also has a defect. It fixes the reference to exp79a. Under R+, if probe 50 displays 0.958, or 0.957 with an attributable UP (we are 16th of 42 in the 0.957 block, so k=15 and the UP test is live), our unrounded best at S0 is exp85a. exp87a must then be coded against exp85a: 0.958 against 0.958 is '0', i.e. NON-ADDITIVE, not '+'. 'V_pub stays exp79a' would also be wrong in that case.

The line explicitly supersedes v3 (1)'s own-base coding for these two files.
